remarks: Updated and expanded walk-to-train gem! Delightful sun-filled 30's Dutch Col, brimming w/charm in East Norwalk. Enter through the enclosed porch, a versatile and spacious area to welcome guests/savor life's moments. The interior showcases original architectural details, including elegant archways, walls of windows and a handsome wood-burning fireplace w/extended mantle, and stunning glass-front built-in bookcases. The home's allure is further accentuated by large moldings that frame the windows and doors, echoing throughout the home and highlighting refinished hardwood floors and baseboards. The living room flows beautifully into the expansive dining room. Updated kitchen w/ss appliances, pristine white cabinets, and stylish butcherblock-patterned countertops offers ample space for an island and provides access to a large basement w/finish potential - currently has laundry/dry storage and a side door leading to driveway. Just beyond the kitchen is the mudroom/pantry, full bathroom, and a back door opening to a deck and flat yard w/delightful eastern exposure. Upstairs, discover 3 generously sized bedrooms, a full bathroom, linen closet, and a large walk-in hall closet w/window-perfectly suited as a nursery or office. Detached garage w/opener fits some SUV's. High-scoring walkability rating offering the best of East Norwalk- train station is a 5 min walk- Norwalk River Esplanade 2 mins, and all Coastal living enjoyment 10 mins!
